performance_case.causal_mechanism: An exact dual-release and active-source verification entrypoint can detect liveness, isolation or release drift before a lost forward day without adding a timer, writer or inferred trust decision, while accurately disclosing its bounded temporary permission probe.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This slice proves only a noninteractive wrapper contract, focused static tests and later one bounded Manager-run server verification whose temporary permission probe is removed. It cannot prove uninterrupted day completion, predictive value, fees, slippage, PnL, drawdown, candidate readiness, OOS or Trading value.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero because no strategy or Trading runtime state changes. Any later path-risk benefit remains contingent on prospective evidence and a separately preregistered matched-capital experiment.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Without a valid and accurately described active-source verifier, an operator may either accept a false read-only claim or discover a dead or drifted source only after the next canonical deadline, losing an untouched day and delaying the first credible strategy decision.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Immediate fee-adjusted total PnL is unchanged; the infrastructure value is reducing avoidable evidence latency and false verification confidence so the bounded Local diagnostic can reach a trustworthy accept-or-reject decision sooner.
